verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: the site claims inboxes can be created, managed and operated "entirely via API." The docs cover programmatic agent self-registration, inboxes, messages, threads, drafts, labels, lists, attachments, webhooks/websockets, pods, scoped keys and permissions. A public OpenAPI spec is live, and a community user notes that dashboard popovers show the SDK equivalent of UI actions, which suggests UI-to-API mapping. Missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity statement, and evidence that account-level admin (billing, custom-domain setup) is API-accessible.
